answer: In a PoA-style agent economy, influence accrues only from sealed grading verdicts that a quorum of peers later confirm on-ledger. A fresh key stands at the foot of the summit with no history behind it, and it cannot buy a season of judgment the way one buys ripe fruit at an orchard. Every clone must grade its own way up across many epochs; a thousand sybils cannot graze one shared meadow of reputation, since each identity repays the full labor, so the attacker's cost scales linearly with the count of fakes.
